sources.facts: Named surviving main house is two storeys in limestone masonry, wooden roof trusses and red clay/Mangalore tiles. Restored exterior columns, balusters and balconies retain original character. Roof profile retained. Annexe and out-houses are described separately; they are excluded here. No exact vertical engineering section stated.

limits: Full original main-house footprint retained. Height13.9m, floor levels, front-bearing registration, balcony projections, roof/room partitions and concealed elevations are photographic medium-fi estimates, not a survey; garden/fountain and detached buildings excluded.
